crossRefs.note: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was…
For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were…
When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy…

translations.web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
translations.bsb: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.
translations.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
translations.asv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
